Rechecked Jacobian determinant x(4z+4y^2+3xy), both ramification parameterizations, and quartic elimination X^4+u^2 X^3+2(v+u^3)X^2+B1. Independent exact SymPy discriminants at four generic rational target points match 256u^4 B1H; the u^4 factor is a generator/chart adjustment, not a third branch component. The two ramification planes are normal A^2; the finite birational restriction to each image proves normalization, and H is irreducible because the quadratic discriminant in x is linear in v. Generic simple branching is verified via reduced discriminant factors; connectedness from irreducibility of source and normal generation of hypersurface-complement meridians give transitive monodromy generated by transpositions, hence S4. Explicit trace determinant rests on inspected multiplication-matrix reconstruction script; four numerical instances alone do not certify its polynomial identity.
